status_note: Real EXTERNAL native-Maven production adaptation to the xstream 1.4.18 default-deny break, in a mature product (Ignite Realtime Spark, XMPP client), found by the pipeline (commit search). Causally clean (tracked issue SPARK-2259, single-line production allowTypes). NOT differential-verifiable standalone: the production class is coupled to a live XMPP session AND swallows the exception (see verification).
discovery_method: bbc_e2e.py run xstream-... -> mine-commits q='xstream ForbiddenClassException' -> classify (native Maven, production). One of 12 *-ranked Maven candidates.

in_repo_version_transition.mechanism: direct dependency; explicit boundary-crossing bump commit
in_repo_version_transition.evidence: Merge commit f0698b7d ('Update XStream to 1.4.18', PR #660) bumps xstream across the 1.4.18 default-deny boundary in the repo's own history; the allowTypes adaptation (SPARK-2259, aad38d68) follows. Strongest in-repo transition of the set: a literal 'Update XStream to 1.4.18' bump commit. (Later f0698b7d -> a4263390 also bumps 1.4.19 -> 1.4.20.)

behavioral_break.mechanism: xstream 1.4.18 default-deny: fromXML on a non-allowlisted class throws com.thoughtworks.xstream.security.ForbiddenClassException.
behavioral_break.live_before_fix: xstream was already 1.4.18 at the fix's parent (3821d04); the break was live before the fix (two-commit pattern).

adaptation.repo_note: Ignite Realtime Spark — a mature open-source XMPP/Jabber client. Multi-module Maven (core module + 20 plugin modules); core depends on the internal 'emoticons' module.
adaptation.commit_message: SPARK-2259 XStream ForbiddenClassException in CustomStatusItem Class
adaptation.in_repo_causal_evidence: Tracked issue SPARK-2259 titled 'XStream ForbiddenClassException in CustomStatusItem Class'; the fix is a single line added to the production static XStream initializer.
adaptation.summary: Allowlisted CustomStatusItem on the production static XStream used by CustomMessages.load()/save(), satisfying xstream 1.4.18 default-deny.

verification.method: reuse-pom multi-module harness GENERATED (scratchpad/xstream-spark-harness, -pl core -am, baseline override on core/pom.xml) — but the differential could not be completed standalone.
blockers: Environment coupling: CustomMessages's static field `new File(SparkManager.getUserDirectory(), ...)` runs at class-load; SparkManager.getUserDirectory() calls sessionManager.getUserBareAddress(), which requires a LIVE XMPP session. Referencing CustomMessages in a bare test NPEs before any xstream call — verifying it would require mocking/standing up a Spark session.

Exception swallowing: CustomMessages.load() catches the exception and returns an empty list, so the break surfaces as empty-vs-populated data, not a thrown exception (testable only via list contents, and only after the environment blocker is solved).
verification.tooling_validated: Confirmed the reuse-pom harness now supports MULTI-MODULE Maven (--module core -> -pl core -am, test into core/src/test/java, baseline override on core/pom.xml). The generator correctly detected the literal xstream 1.4.18 in core/pom.xml.
verification.conclusion: Signature-confirmed real external native-Maven production adaptation in a mature product. Not standalone-differential-verifiable due to live-session coupling + exception swallowing — a general trait of framework-coupled real apps (contrast TVRenamer's simple standalone preference persister).

lesson: Native-Maven xstream clients found in the wild are mostly FRAMEWORK-COUPLED (Spark's XMPP session; Axon apps' Spring XStreamConfig beans), so their production xstream path is not exercisable without the framework running. TVRenamer verified cleanly precisely because it was a SIMPLE standalone preferences persister. For a Maven-verifiable BBC, prioritise clients whose adapted production path is callable without app/framework bootstrap.
